chunks: And whatever was in H from Rūmī ibn Zurārah, I have narrated it from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad ibn Masrūr—may Allah be pleased with him—from al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĀmir, from his uncle ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿĀmir, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Rūmī ibn Zurārah.

key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicating the author's mode of narration.
key_terms.رُومِيِّ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ: A narrator from whom reports are transmitted in this chain.
key_terms.عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ: Part of the documented sanad/isnad leading to the named narrator.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Rūmī ibn Zurārah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Rūmī ibn Zurārah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission rather than presenting a legal or theological teaching.
